name: kb_context
description: Check freshness of files against the knowledge bank. Returns {fresh, stale, missing} -- fresh files can be skipped, stale/missing files must be re-read. In a MEMBER session freshness is judged against entries from the member's checkout bible. Scope: always the calling session's own KB -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument. Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER, E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO or E-SELF-NO-REMOTE (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder cannot carry a KB identity (it must be a git repository with an origin remote).
